qe: After decreasing by 25%, the cost of a jacket becomes ₹4,500. Find its original cost.
qh: 25% की कमी के बाद, एक जैकेट का मूल्य ₹4,500 हो जाता है। इसका मूल मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
$25\% = \frac{1}{4}$.
Original Cost : Decreased Cost $= 4 : (4 - 1) = 4 : 3$.
Given: 3 units $= ₹4500 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = \frac{4500}{3} = ₹1500$.
Original Cost = 4 units $= 4 \times 1500 = ₹6000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹6,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Original cost ko $100\%$ maan lo.
$25\%$ decrease ke baad cost $= 100\% - 25\% = 75\%$.
Given: $75\% = ₹4500$.
$1\% = \frac{4500}{75} = ₹60$.
Original Cost ($100\%$) $= 60 \times 100 = ₹6000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹6,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The price of a laptop was ₹80,000 last year. This year, its price decreased by 20%. What is the price (in ₹) of the laptop this year?

Given: 5 units $= ₹80000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = \frac{80000}{5} = ₹16000$.
New Price = 4 units $= 4 \times 16000 = ₹64000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹64,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Original Price $= 100\% = ₹80000$.
Price $20\%$ decrease hone ke baad bacha $= 80\%$.
New Price $= 80\% \text{ of } 80000 = \frac{80}{100} \times 80000 = ₹64000$.

Net hike $= 10 + 10 + \frac{10 \times 10}{100} = 21\%$.
Salary in 2023 $= 30000 + (21\% \text{ of } 30000) = 30000 + 6300 = ₹36300$.

qe: If 25% of 40% of a number is 180, then 15% of that number is:
qh: यदि किसी संख्या के 40% का 25% मान 180 है, तो उस संख्या का 15% क्या होगा?

Method 1 (Ratio Method):
$25\% = \frac{1}{4}$ aur $40\% = \frac{2}{5}$.
Fractional part $= \frac{1}{4} \times \frac{2}{5} = \frac{1}{10}$.
Given: $\frac{1}{10}$ of number $= 180 \implies \text{Number} = 1800$.
Ab number ka $15\%$ nikaalna hai:
$15\% = \frac{3}{20} \implies \frac{3}{20} \times 1800 = 3 \times 90 = 270$.
Atah sahi vikalp  270 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Let the number be $100\%$.
$40\% \text{ of } 100\% = 40\%$.
$25\% \text{ of } 40\% = 10\%$.
Given: $10\% = 180$.
$1\% = 18$.
Required $15\% = 15 \times 18 = 270$.
Atah sahi uttar '270' hai.

Atah sahi vikalp  60,000 hai.

Method 2 (Successive Formula):
Net percentage change $= +10 - 10 - \frac{10 \times 10}{100} = -1\%$.
Final population $= 100\% - 1\% = 99\%$.
$99\% = 59400 \implies 1\% = 600$.
Initial population ($100\%$) $= 600 \times 100 = 60000$.
Atah sahi uttar '60,000' hai.

qe: The price of an article is increased by k%. The new price was decreased by k% later. Now the latest price is ₹P. What was the original price of the article?
qh: एक वस्तु के मूल्य में k% की वृद्धि की जाती है। बाद में नए मूल्य में k% की कमी की जाती है। अब नवीनतम मूल्य ₹P है। वस्तु का मूल मूल्य क्या था?
e:
Method 1 (Successive Multiplier Method):
Pehle $k\%$ badhane par factor $= \left(1 + \frac{k}{100}\right)$.
Fir $k\%$ ghatane par factor $= \left(1 - \frac{k}{100}\right)$.
Net Multiplier $= \left(1 + \frac{k}{100}\right)\left(1 - \frac{k}{100}\right) = 1 - \frac{k^2}{10000} = \frac{10000 - k^2}{10000}$.
Latest Price $= \text{Original Price} \times \frac{10000 - k^2}{10000} = P$.
$\implies \text{Original Price} = \frac{10000 P}{10000 - k^2}$.
Atah sahi vikalp  $\frac{10000P}{10000-k^2}$ hai.

Method 2 (100-Base / Direct Loss Formula):
Jab kisi value ko pehle $k\%$ badhayein aur fir $k\%$ ghatayein, toh net loss $= \frac{k^2}{100}\%$ hota hai.
Final percentage $= 100\% - \frac{k^2}{100}\% = \frac{10000 - k^2}{100}\%$.
Ye value $P$ ke barabar hai:
$\frac{10000 - k^2}{10000} \times \text{Original} = P \implies \text{Original} = \frac{10000 P}{10000 - k^2}$.
Atah sahi uttar '$\frac{10000P}{10000-k^2}$' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The population of a town increases by 10% in the first year, decreases by 20% in the second year, and again increases by 30% in the third year. If the population at the beginning was 50,000, what will it be after 3 years?
qh: एक शहर की जनसंख्या पहले वर्ष में 10% बढ़ती है, दूसरे वर्ष में 20% घटती है, और तीसरे वर्ष में पुनः 30% बढ़ती है। यदि शुरुआत में जनसंख्या 50,000 थी, तो 3 वर्ष बाद यह कितनी होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Year 1 (+10%): $10 : 11$.
Year 2 (-20%): $5 : 4$.
Year 3 (+30%): $10 : 13$.
Initial : Final $= (10 \times 5 \times 10) : (11 \times 4 \times 13) = 500 : 572$.
Given: 500 units $= 50000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 100$.
Population after 3 years = 572 units $= 572 \times 100 = 57200$.
Atah sahi vikalp  57,200 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial population $= 100$.
After Year 1 (+10%): $100 + 10 = 110$.
After Year 2 (-20%): $110 - (20\% \text{ of } 110) = 110 - 22 = 88$.
After Year 3 (+30%): $88 + (30\% \text{ of } 88) = 88 + 26.4 = 114.4$.
Population after 3 years $= 50000 \times \frac{114.4}{100} = 500 \times 114.4 = 57200$.
Atah sahi uttar '57,200' hai.

Initial : Final $= (10 \times 5 \times 20) : (11 \times 6 \times 19) = 1000 : 1254$.
Given: 1000 units $= 20000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 20$.
Population after 3 years = 1254 units $= 1254 \times 20 = 25080$.
Atah sahi vikalp  25,080 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial population $= 20000$.
After Year 1 (+10%): $20000 + 2000 = 22000$.
After Year 2 (+20%): $22000 + 4400 = 26400$.
After Year 3 (-5%): $26400 - (5\% \text{ of } 26400) = 26400 - 1320 = 25080$.
Atah sahi uttar '25,080' hai.

qe: Deepak studies the pattern of daily sale of a grocery shop. He finds that on Monday, the sale was decreased by 20% in comparison to the sale on Sunday. On Tuesday, the sale was increased by 20% in comparison to the sale of Monday. If the sale on Tuesday was of ₹2,880, how much was the sale on Sunday?
qh: दीपक एक किराना दुकान की दैनिक बिक्री के पैटर्न का अध्ययन करता है। वह पाता है कि रविवार की बिक्री की तुलना में सोमवार को बिक्री में 20% की कमी आई। सोमवार की बिक्री की तुलना में मंगलवार को बिक्री में 20% की वृद्धि हुई। यदि मंगलवार को ₹2,880 की बिक्री हुई, तो रविवार को बिक्री कितनी थी?
e:
Method 1 (Equal Change Direct Shortcut):
Jab kisi base value ko pehle $x\%$ ghatayein aur fir $x\%$ badhayein, toh net loss $= \frac{x^2}{100}\%$ hota hai.
Net loss $= \frac{20^2}{100}\% = 4\%$.
Sunday ki sale ke mukable Tuesday ki sale $= 100\% - 4\% = 96\%$.
Given: $96\% = ₹2880$.
$1\% = \frac{2880}{96} = ₹30$.
Sunday ki sale ($100\%$) $= 30 \times 100 = ₹3000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹3,000 hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Method):
Monday (-20%): $5 : 4$.
Tuesday (+20%): $5 : 6$.
Sunday : Tuesday $= (5 \times 5) : (4 \times 6) = 25 : 24$.
Given: 24 units $= ₹2880 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = \frac{2880}{24} = ₹120$.
Sunday's sale = 25 units $= 25 \times 120 = ₹3000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹3,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The price of a car increases by 25% in the first year and decreases by 20% in the second year. If its final price becomes ₹4,80,000, find the original price of the car.
qh: एक कार के मूल्य में पहले वर्ष 25% की वृद्धि होती है और दूसरे वर्ष 20% की कमी होती है। यदि इसका अंतिम मूल्य ₹4,80,000 हो जाता है, तो कार का मूल मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Year 1 (+25%): $25\% = \frac{1}{4} \implies 4 : 5$.
Year 2 (-20%): $20\% = \frac{1}{5} \implies 5 : 4$.
Original Price : Final Price $= (4 \times 5) : (5 \times 4) = 20 : 20 = 1 : 1$.
Since ratio is $1 : 1$, Original Price $=$ Final Price $= ₹480000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹4,80,000 hai.

Method 2 (Successive Formula):
Net Change $= +25 - 20 + \frac{25 \times (-20)}{100} = 5 - 5 = 0\%$.
Kyunki net change $0\%$ hai, isliye price unaltered rahega.
Original Price $= ₹480000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹4,80,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: 10% of the inhabitants of a village having died of an epidemic, a panic set in, during which 20% of the remaining inhabitants left the village. The population was then reduced to 14,400. What was the number of inhabitants initially?
qh: एक महामारी से एक गाँव के 10% निवासियों की मृत्यु हो जाने के बाद, दहशत फैल गई, जिसके दौरान शेष निवासियों में से 20% ने गाँव छोड़ दिया। इसके बाद जनसंख्या घटकर 14,400 हो गई। शुरुआत में निवासियों की संख्या क्या थी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1 (-10%): $10 : 9$.
Step 2 (-20%): $5 : 4$.
Initial Population : Final Population $= (10 \times 5) : (9 \times 4) = 50 : 36 = 25 : 18$.
Given: 18 units $= 14400 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = \frac{14400}{18} = 800$.
Initial Population = 25 units $= 25 \times 800 = 20000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  20,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial population $= 100\%$.
After epidemic deaths: $100 - 10 = 90\%$.
After migration of remaining: $90\% - (20\% \text{ of } 90\%) = 90 - 18 = 72\%$.
Given: $72\% = 14400$.
$1\% = \frac{14400}{72} = 200$.
Initial Population ($100\%$) $= 200 \times 100 = 20000$.
Atah sahi uttar '20,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: On account of a viral outbreak, 10% of the population of a village died. Out of the remaining population, 25% fled due to panic. If the present population is 5,400, then what was the population of the village before the outbreak?
qh: वायरस के प्रकोप के कारण एक गाँव की 10% जनसंख्या की मृत्यु हो गई। शेष जनसंख्या में से 25% दहशत के कारण भाग गए। यदि वर्तमान जनसंख्या 5,400 है, तो प्रकोप से पहले गाँव की जनसंख्या क्या थी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1 (-10%): $10 : 9$.
Step 2 (-25%): $4 : 3$.
Initial Population : Present Population $= (10 \times 4) : (9 \times 3) = 40 : 27$.
Given: 27 units $= 5400 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = \frac{5400}{27} = 200$.
Initial Population = 40 units $= 40 \times 200 = 8000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  8,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial population $= 100\%$.
After deaths: $100 - 10 = 90\%$.
After panic exit: $90\% - (25\% \text{ of } 90\%) = 90 - 22.5 = 67.5\%$.
Given: $67.5\% = 5400$.
$1\% = \frac{5400}{67.5} = 80$.
Initial Population ($100\%$) $= 80 \times 100 = 8000$.
Atah sahi uttar '8,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A town has a present population of 1,60,000. Every year the population increases by a birth rate of 15% and decreases by a death rate of 5%. Find the population of the town at the end of 3 years.
qh: एक शहर की वर्तमान जनसंख्या 1,60,000 है। प्रत्येक वर्ष जनसंख्या में 15% की जन्म दर से वृद्धि होती है और 5% की मृत्यु दर से कमी होती है। 3 वर्ष के अंत में शहर की जनसंख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Net annual growth rate $= \text{Birth Rate} - \text{Death Rate} = 15\% - 5\% = 10\%$.
$10\% = \frac{1}{10} \implies$ Har saal population ratio $= 10 : 11$.
3 saal baad ratio $= 10^3 : 11^3 = 1000 : 1331$.
Initial base 1000 units $= 160000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 160$.
Population at the end of 3 years $= 1331 \times 160 = 212960$.
Atah sahi vikalp  2,12,960 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base / Multiplier Method):
Har saal net growth $10\%$ hai, isliye multiplier factor $= 1.10$ hoga.
Population after 3 years $= 160000 \times (1.10)^3 = 160000 \times 1.331 = 212960$.
Atah sahi uttar '2,12,960' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The number of items produced by a manufacturing unit in 2020 was 40,000, which increased by 25% in 2021. In 2022, the production was affected by a raw material shortage and it fell by 20%. How many total items were manufactured in these three years combined?
qh: 2020 में एक विनिर्माण इकाई द्वारा उत्पादित वस्तुओं की संख्या 40,000 थी, जो 2021 में 25% बढ़ गई। 2022 में, कच्चे माल की कमी से उत्पादन प्रभावित हुआ और यह 20% गिर गया। इन तीन वर्षों में कुल मिलाकर कितनी वस्तुओं का निर्माण किया गया?
e:
Method 1 (Step-by-Step Production Method):
• Production in 2020 $= 40000$.
• Production in 2021 ($+25\%$): $40000 + (25\% \text{ of } 40000) = 40000 + 10000 = 50000$.
• Production in 2022 ($-20\%$ on 2021): $50000 - (20\% \text{ of } 50000) = 50000 - 10000 = 40000$.
Total production in three years $= 40000 + 50000 + 40000 = 130000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  1,30,000 hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Multiplier Method):
Production in 2020 $= 40000$.
Production in 2021 $= 40000 \times \frac{5}{4} = 50000$.
Production in 2022 $= 50000 \times \frac{4}{5} = 40000$.
Total $= 40000 + 50000 + 40000 = 130000$.
Atah sahi uttar '1,30,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: During 2022, the population of a town increased by 10% and in 2023, it increased by 20%. At the end of 2023, its population was 66,000. What was the population of the town at the end of 2022?
qh: 2022 के दौरान, एक शहर की जनसंख्या में 10% की वृद्धि हुई और 2023 में इसमें 20% की वृद्धि हुई। 2023 के अंत में इसकी जनसंख्या 66,000 थी। 2022 के अंत में शहर की जनसंख्या कितनी थी?
e:
Method 1 (Single Step Backtrack Method):
Question me specifically end of 2022 ki population puchi gayi hai. 2022 ke end se 2023 ke end tak sirf $20\%$ ki increase hui hai:
$20\% = \frac{1}{5} \implies$ Population at end of 2022 : Population at end of 2023 $= 5 : 6$.
Given: 6 units $= 66000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 11000$.
Population at end of 2022 = 5 units $= 5 \times 11000 = 55000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  55,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
End of 2022 ki population ko $100\%$ maan lo.
2023 ke end me population $= 100\% + 20\% = 120\%$.
Given: $120\% = 66000$.
$1\% = \frac{66000}{120} = 550$.
Population at end of 2022 ($100\%$) $= 550 \times 100 = 55000$.
Atah sahi uttar '55,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Two years ago, the population of a locality was 80,000. It increased by 10% in the first year, but due to health issues, it decreased by 5% in the second year. What is its present population?
qh: दो वर्ष पहले, एक इलाके की जनसंख्या 80,000 थी। पहले वर्ष में इसमें 10% की वृद्धि हुई, लेकिन स्वास्थ्य समस्याओं के कारण दूसरे वर्ष में 5% की कमी आई। इसकी वर्तमान जनसंख्या क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Year 1 (+10%): $10 : 11$.
Year 2 (-5%): $20 : 19$.
Initial Population : Present Population $= (10 \times 20) : (11 \times 19) = 200 : 209$.
Given: 200 units $= 80000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = \frac{80000}{200} = 400$.
Present population = 209 units $= 209 \times 400 = 83600$.
Atah sahi vikalp  83,600 hai.

Method 2 (Successive Net Change Method):
Net percentage change $= +10 - 5 + \frac{10 \times (-5)}{100} = 5 - 0.5 = +4.5\%$.
Present population $= 80000 + (4.5\% \text{ of } 80000) = 80000 + 3600 = 83600$.
Atah sahi uttar '83,600' hai.

qe: A bacteria culture increases by 10% every hour for the first 2 hours, then decreases by 20% in the 3rd hour, and finally increases by 25% in the 4th hour. If the initial count was 10,000, what will be the count after 4 hours?
qh: एक बैक्टीरिया संवर्धन (culture) में पहले 2 घंटों में प्रत्येक घंटे 10% की वृद्धि होती है, फिर तीसरे घंटे में 20% की कमी होती है, और अंत में चौथे घंटे में 25% की वृद्धि होती है। यदि प्रारंभिक संख्या 10,000 थी, तो 4 घंटे बाद संख्या क्या होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Multiplication Method):
1st hour (+10%): $\frac{11}{10}$
2nd hour (+10%): $\frac{11}{10}$
3rd hour (-20%): $\frac{4}{5}$
4th hour (+25%): $\frac{5}{4}$
Final Count $= 10000 \times \frac{11}{10} \times \frac{11}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{5}{4} = 10000 \times \frac{121}{100} \times 1 = 12100$.
Atah sahi vikalp  12,100 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Step Method):
Initial count $= 10000$.
After 1st hour: $10000 + 1000 = 11000$.
After 2nd hour: $11000 + 1100 = 12100$.
After 3rd hour: $12100 - (20\% \text{ of } 12100) = 12100 - 2420 = 9680$.
After 4th hour: $9680 + (25\% \text{ of } 9680) = 9680 + 2420 = 12100$.
Atah sahi uttar '12,100' hai.

Exam point: jiv vigyan ke tathy - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: In the first year, the population of a town decreased by 10%. In the next year, it decreased again by 10%, and in the third year, it increased by 10%. At the end of the third year, the population was 89,100. What was the population at the beginning of the first year?
qh: पहले वर्ष में एक कस्बे की जनसंख्या में 10% की कमी आई। अगले वर्ष इसमें फिर से 10% की कमी आई और तीसरे वर्ष इसमें 10% की वृद्धि हुई। तीसरे वर्ष के अंत में जनसंख्या 89,100 थी। पहले वर्ष की शुरुआत में जनसंख्या कितनी थी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Year 1 (-10%): $10 : 9$
Year 2 (-10%): $10 : 9$
Year 3 (+10%): $10 : 11$
Initial Population : Final Population $= (10 \times 10 \times 10) : (9 \times 9 \times 11) = 1000 : 891$.
Given: 891 units $= 89100 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 100$.
Initial Population = 1000 units $= 1000 \times 100 = 100000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  1,00,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Fraction Method):
Final population factor $= \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{11}{10} = \frac{891}{1000}$.
$\text{Initial Population} \times \frac{891}{1000} = 89100 \implies \text{Initial Population} = 100000$.
Atah sahi uttar '1,00,000' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The number of students in a school is 50,000 and it is increasing annually by 20%. What will be the number of students in the school at the end of 3 years?
qh: एक विद्यालय में विद्यार्थियों की संख्या 50,000 है और इसमें प्रतिवर्ष 20% की वृद्धि हो रही है। 3 वर्ष के अंत में विद्यालय में विद्यार्थियों की संख्या क्या होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
$20\% = \frac{1}{5} \implies$ Growth ratio $= 5 : 6$.
After 3 years, ratio $= 5^3 : 6^3 = 125 : 216$.
Given: 125 units $= 50000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = \frac{50000}{125} = 400$.
Students after 3 years = 216 units $= 216 \times 400 = 86400$.
Atah sahi vikalp  86,400 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Successive Formula):
3 successive increases of $20\%$:
Step 1 (2 years): $20 + 20 + \frac{20 \times 20}{100} = 44\%$.
Step 2 (3 years): $44 + 20 + \frac{44 \times 20}{100} = 64 + 8.8 = 72.8\%$.
Students after 3 years $= 50000 + (72.8\% \text{ of } 50000) = 50000 + 36400 = 86400$.
Atah sahi uttar '86,400' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The strength of a school increases and decreases in alternate years by 10%. It started with an increase in 2016 and the initial strength was 5,000. Find the strength of the school in 2018 and the net percentage increase from 2016, respectively.
qh: एक विद्यालय की छात्र संख्या में प्रत्येक एकांतर वर्ष में 10% की वृद्धि और कमी होती है। इसकी शुरुआत 2016 में वृद्धि के साथ हुई और प्रारंभिक छात्र संख्या 5,000 थी। वर्ष 2018 में विद्यालय की छात्र संख्या तथा छात्र संख्या में कुल प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्रमशः ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
2016 se 2018 tak kul 2 saal ka badlav hua (Year 1: $+10\%$, Year 2: $-10\%$):
Year 1: $10 : 11$, Year 2: $10 : 9$.
Initial : Final $= (10 \times 10) : (11 \times 9) = 100 : 99$.
100 units $= 5000 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 50$.
Final strength $= 99 \times 50 = 4950$.
Net change $= 99 - 100 = -1\%$ (1% decrease).
Atah sahi vikalp  4,950, 1% decrease hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial strength $= 5000$.
2017 ke end me ($+10\%$): $5000 + 500 = 5500$.
2018 ke end me ($-10\%$): $5500 - 550 = 4950$.
Net decrease $= 5000 - 4950 = 50$.
Percentage change $= \frac{50}{5000} \times 100\% = 1\%$ decrease.
Atah sahi uttar '4,950, 1% decrease' hai.

Exam point: pratishat ka hisaab - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The population of a city increased to 40,000 from 2018 to 2020 at the rate of 10% per annum, and continued the same trend for the next 2 years. If X is the population in 2018 and Y is the population in 2022, find the value of Y - X (rounded to nearest integer).
qh: एक शहर की जनसंख्या 2018 से 2020 तक 10% वार्षिक दर से बढ़कर 40,000 हो गई, और अगले 2 वर्षों तक यही क्रम जारी रहा। यदि X वर्ष 2018 की जनसंख्या है और Y वर्ष 2022 की जनसंख्या है, तो Y - X का मान ज्ञात कीजिए (निकटतम पूर्णांक तक)।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Annual growth $= 10\% = \frac{1}{10} \implies$ Multiplier per year $= \frac{11}{10}$.
2020 ki population $= 40000$.
2018 ki population ($X$) $= 40000 \times \left(\frac{10}{11}\right)^2 = \frac{4000000}{121} \approx 33057.85$.
2022 ki population ($Y$) $= 40000 \times \left(\frac{11}{10}\right)^2 = 40000 \times 1.21 = 48400$.
Difference $Y - X = 48400 - 33057.85 = 15342.15 \approx 15342$.
Atah sahi vikalp  15,342 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
$X = \frac{40000}{1.21} = 33057.85$.
$Y = 40000 \times 1.21 = 48400$.
$Y - X = 48400 - 33057.85 \approx 15342$.
Atah sahi uttar '15,342' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Suresh spends 20% of his monthly salary on house rent and 60% of the remaining on other household expenses. If he saves ₹4,800 per month, find his total monthly salary (in ₹).
qh: सुरेश अपने मासिक वेतन का 20% घर के किराए पर और शेष का 60% अन्य घरेलू खर्चों पर खर्च करता है। यदि वह प्रति माह ₹4,800 बचाता है, तो उसका कुल मासिक वेतन (₹ में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Rent: $20\% = \frac{1}{5} \implies$ Remaining $= 5 - 1 = 4$ units.
Household: $60\% = \frac{3}{5} \implies$ Remaining savings $= 5 - 3 = 2$ units.
Total : Savings $= (5 \times 5) : (4 \times 2) = 25 : 8$.
Given: 8 units $= ₹4800 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = \frac{4800}{8} = ₹600$.
Total Salary = 25 units $= 25 \times 600 = ₹15000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹15,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Total salary $= 100\%$.
Rent $= 20\% \implies$ Remaining $= 80\%$.
Household expenses $= 60\% \text{ of } 80\% = 48\%$.
Savings $= 80\% - 48\% = 32\%$.
Given: $32\% = ₹4800$.
$1\% = \frac{4800}{32} = ₹150$.
Total salary ($100\%$) $= 150 \times 100 = ₹15000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹15,000' hai.

qe: A man spent 50% of his salary on household expenses, 25% of his salary on rent, and out of the remaining salary, he donated 60% to a charitable trust. If he is left with ₹16,000, then what is his total salary?
qh: एक व्यक्ति ने अपने वेतन का 50% घरेलू खर्चों पर, 25% किराए पर खर्च किया और शेष वेतन में से 60% एक धर्मार्थ ट्रस्ट को दान कर दिया। यदि उसके पास ₹16,000 शेष बचते हैं, तो उसका कुल वेतन क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Direct expenses on salary $= 50\% + 25\% = 75\% = \frac{3}{4}$.
Remaining salary $= 1 - \frac{3}{4} = \frac{1}{4}$.
Donation out of remaining $= 60\% = \frac{3}{5} \implies$ Final savings $= 1 - \frac{3}{5} = \frac{2}{5}$ of remaining.
Net fraction left $= \frac{1}{4} \times \frac{2}{5} = \frac{1}{10}$.
Given: 1 unit $= ₹16000$.
Total Salary = 10 units $= 10 \times 16000 = ₹160000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹1,60,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Total salary $= 100\%$.
Household + Rent $= 50\% + 25\% = 75\%$.
Remaining $= 100\% - 75\% = 25\%$.
Donation $= 60\% \text{ of } 25\% = 15\%$.
Remaining balance $= 25\% - 15\% = 10\%$.
Given: $10\% = ₹16000$.
Total salary ($100\%$) $= 16000 \times 10 = ₹160000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹1,60,000' hai.

qe: A father gives 10% of his monthly income to both his sons as pocket money. The elder son gets 80% of the total amount given to both the sons. He spends 75% of his amount and saves ₹50. What is the monthly income of the father?

Pocket money $= \frac{1}{10}$ of father's income.
Elder son's share $= 80\% = \frac{4}{5}$ of pocket money.
Elder son's savings $= 100\% - 75\% = 25\% = \frac{1}{4}$ of his share.
Father's income ka fraction jo elder son bachata hai $= \frac{1}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{1}{50}$.
Given: $\frac{1}{50}$ of Father's Income $= ₹50$.
Father's Income $= 50 \times 50 = ₹2500$.

Father's income $= 100\%$.
Total pocket money $= 10\%$.
Elder son's pocket money $= 80\% \text{ of } 10\% = 8\%$.
Elder son saves $25\%$ of his amount:
Savings $= 25\% \text{ of } 8\% = 2\%$.
Given: $2\% = ₹50$.
$1\% = ₹25$.

qe: Three years ago, Raman's salary was ₹50,000. His salary was increased by 20%, A%, and 10% in the first, second, and third year, respectively. Raman's present salary is ₹79,200. What is the value of A?
qh: तीन वर्ष पहले, रमन का वेतन ₹50,000 था। उसके वेतन में पहले, दूसरे और तीसरे वर्ष में क्रमशः 20%, A% और 10% की वृद्धि हुई। रमन का वर्तमान वेतन ₹79,200 है। A का मान क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Step-by-Step Backtrack Method):
Initial salary (3 years ago) $= ₹50000$.
After Year 1 (+20%): $50000 + 10000 = ₹60000$.
Present salary (after Year 3) $= ₹79200$.
Year 3 me $10\%$ hike mili thi, isliye Year 2 ke end ka salary:
$\text{Salary after Year 2} \times \frac{110}{100} = 79200 \implies \text{Salary after Year 2} = \frac{79200 \times 10}{11} = ₹72000$.
Ab Year 1 ke end ($₹60000$) se Year 2 ke end ($₹72000$) tak ka hike:
$\text{Increase} = 72000 - 60000 = ₹12000$.
$A = \frac{12000}{60000} \times 100\% = 20\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  20% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Method):
Overall multiplier $= \frac{79200}{50000} = \frac{198}{125}$.
Year 1 multiplier $= \frac{6}{5}$, Year 3 multiplier $= \frac{11}{10}$.
Year 2 multiplier $= \frac{198}{125} \div \left(\frac{6}{5} \times \frac{11}{10}\right) = \frac{198}{125} \times \frac{25}{33} = \frac{6}{5}$.
Multiplier $\frac{6}{5} \implies A = \frac{6 - 5}{5} \times 100\% = 20\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '20%' hai.

qe: 60% of students in a class are girls and 75% of girls have chosen badminton as their favourite sport. If 135 girls have chosen badminton as their favourite sport, what is the total number of students in the class?

Total students ka fraction jo badminton chunti hain $= \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{3}{4} = \frac{9}{20}$.

$1\% = \frac{135}{45} = 3$.

Atah sahi uttar '300' hai.

qe: The population of a town in 2005 was 8,000, and in 2008 it grew to 10,648. Find the rate of growth per annum if it increases at a constant rate every year.
qh: 2005 में एक कस्बे की जनसंख्या 8,000 थी, और 2008 में यह बढ़कर 10,648 हो गई। यदि यह प्रत्येक वर्ष एक समान दर से बढ़ती है, तो प्रति वर्ष वृद्धि की दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Time period $= 2008 - 2005 = 3\text{ years}$.
Initial Population : Final Population $= 8000 : 10648 = 1000 : 1331$.
3 saal ka compounding hai, isliye 1 saal ka ratio nikalne ke liye cube root $(\sqrt[3]{\phantom{x}})$ lenge:
1-Year Ratio $= \sqrt[3]{1000} : \sqrt[3]{1331} = 10 : 11$.
Increase per year $= 11 - 10 = 1$ unit (10 ke base par).
Rate of growth per annum $= \frac{1}{10} \times 100\% = 10\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  10% hai.

Method 2 (Formula Method):
$\frac{10648}{8000} = \left(1 + \frac{r}{100}\right)^3 \implies \left(\frac{11}{10}\right)^3 = \left(1 + \frac{r}{100}\right)^3$.
$1 + \frac{r}{100} = \frac{11}{10} \implies r = 10\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '10%' hai.

qe: The income of a company increases by x% per year. If its income is ₹43,20,000 in the year 2020, and the income in 2018 was ₹30,00,000, then what is the value of x?
qh: एक कंपनी की आय प्रति वर्ष x% बढ़ती है। यदि 2020 में इसकी आय ₹43,20,000 है, और 2018 में आय ₹30,00,000 थी, तो x का मान क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Time period $= 2020 - 2018 = 2\text{ years}$.
Income 2018 : Income 2020 $= 3000000 : 4320000 = 25 : 36$.
2 saal ka successive multiplier hai, isliye 1 saal ka factor nikalne ke liye square root lenge:
1-Year Ratio $= \sqrt{25} : \sqrt{36} = 5 : 6$.
Annual growth $= 6 - 5 = 1$ unit (5 ke base par).
$x = \frac{1}{5} \times 100\% = 20\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  20% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
2 saal ka total growth factor $= \frac{4320000}{3000000} = 1.44$.
$(1 + x\%)^2 = 1.44 \implies 1 + x\% = 1.20 \implies x\% = 20\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '20%' hai.

qe: A shopkeeper has a certain length of cable wire. 20% of the wire is stolen and 60% of the remaining was sold out. Find the original length of the wire if 960 meters is still left.

$20\%$ chori hone ke baad bacha $= 80\%$.

Remaining balance $= 80\% - 48\% = 32\%$.
Given: $32\% = 960\text{ meters}$.
$1\% = \frac{960}{32} = 30\text{ meters}$.
Original length ($100\%$) $= 30 \times 100 = 3000\text{ meters}$.

qe: In a library, 10% of the books are in Hindi, 40% of the remaining are in English, and 50% of the remaining are in French, while the rest 8,100 books are in regional languages. Find the total number of books in the library.

French: $50\% = \frac{1}{2} \implies$ Left $= 2 - 1 = 1$ unit.
Total Books : Regional Language Books $= (10 \times 5 \times 2) : (9 \times 3 \times 1) = 100 : 27$.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):

After Hindi ($10\%$): $100 - 10 = 90\%$.
After English ($40\% \text{ of } 90\% = 36\%$): $90 - 36 = 54\%$.
After French ($50\% \text{ of } 54\% = 27\%$): $54 - 27 = 27\%$.
Given: $27\% = 8100$.
$1\% = \frac{8100}{27} = 300$.
Total books ($100\%$) $= 300 \times 100 = 30000$.

qe: Pooja spends 10% of her total income on travelling and 25% of the rest on food. She then donates ₹200 to an orphanage and is still left with ₹2,500. Find her total income.
qh: पूजा अपनी कुल आय का 10% यात्रा पर और शेष का 25% भोजन पर खर्च करती है। फिर वह एक अनाथालय में ₹200 दान करती है और फिर भी उसके पास ₹2,500 शेष बचते हैं। उसकी कुल आय ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Backtrack Method):
Donation dene se pehle bachi hui rashi $= ₹2500 + ₹200 = ₹2700$.
Travelling ke baad bachi hui income ka $25\% (\frac{1}{4})$ khane me kharch hua, toh bacha $\frac{3}{4}$:
$\frac{3}{4} \times \text{Remaining after travel} = 2700 \implies \text{Remaining after travel} = 2700 \times \frac{4}{3} = ₹3600$.
Travelling me total income ka $10\% (\frac{1}{10})$ gaya, toh bacha $\frac{9}{10}$:
$\frac{9}{10} \times \text{Total Income} = 3600 \implies \text{Total Income} = 3600 \times \frac{10}{9} = ₹4000$.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹4,000 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Total income $= 100\%$.
After travel ($10\%$): $100 - 10 = 90\%$.
Food expense $= 25\% \text{ of } 90\% = 22.5\%$.
Remaining percentage $= 90\% - 22.5\% = 67.5\%$.
Donation ke baad bacha ₹2500, yaani donation milakar bachi amount $= 2500 + 200 = ₹2700$.
$67.5\% = ₹2700$.
$1\% = \frac{2700}{67.5} = ₹40$.
Total Income ($100\%$) $= 40 \times 100 = ₹4000$.
Atah sahi uttar '₹4,000' hai.
